questions.question: Which Ycf1 construct yielded the two inward-facing cryo-EM states, and what were their resolutions?

options.B: Wild type, at 3.4 Å and 4.0 Å
options.D: Wild type, at 6.0 Å and 7.5 Å

questions.rationale: Only the E1435Q dataset yielded homogeneous particles and two inward-facing conformations resolved at the reported values.
questions.evidence_quote: only the E1435Q Ycf1 dataset yielded homogenous particles from which we successfully identified not one but two inward-facing conformations determined to 3.4Å and 4.0Å resolution

questions.question: Which residues and phosphorylation count were assigned in the resolved Ycf1 R-domain?

options.A: S908, T911 and S914; three phosphosites
options.B: S908, S911 and T914; two phosphosites
options.C: T901, S920 and S929; three phosphosites
options.D: S251, T911 and S914; two phosphosites

questions.rationale: The structural density, mass spectrometry and phosphostaining supported phosphorylation at those three positions.
questions.evidence_quote: We assigned phosphorylation to S908, T911, and S914 in our model based on pronounced additional electron potential density at these residues

questions.question: How is the ordered R-domain segmented structurally in the reported model?

options.A: Residues 920–929 form a C-terminal helix; 901–919 and 930–935 lack secondary structure
options.B: Residues 901–919 form a helix, while residues 920–935 are disordered
options.D: Residues 901–929 are disordered, with a helix at 930–935

questions.rationale: The R-domain structure has a short C-terminal helix and flanking segments without secondary structure.
questions.evidence_quote: The Rdomain is helical (residues 920-929) in the C-terminal segment and lacks secondary structure (residues 901-919 and 930-935) in the other.

questions.question: Which basic residues receive phosphate contacts from the R-domain in the structural model?

options.A: R716 on NBD1 and R206 on the lasso domain
options.B: R206 on NBD1 and R716 on the lasso domain
options.D: R901 and R935 on the R-domain itself

questions.rationale: The three R-domain phosphates contact guanidyl groups of R716 on NBD1 and R206 on the lasso domain.
questions.evidence_quote: R716 on NBD1 and R206 on the lasso domain

questions.question: What happened to Ycf1 protease accessibility after phosphatase treatment, and what structural interpretation did the authors favor?

options.A: Digestion became more complete with fewer intermediate bands, consistent with altered R-domain position or conformation
options.B: Digestion decreased, consistent with a more compact and protected R-domain
options.C: The digestion pattern was unchanged, indicating phosphorylation does not alter architecture
options.D: Only the NBD2 region was digested, indicating increased ATP occupancy

questions.rationale: Dephosphorylated Ycf1 showed increased trypsin accessibility and loss of intermediate fragments, which the authors linked to phosphorylation-dependent conformational changes.
questions.evidence_quote: dephosphorylated Ycf1 substantially changes the digestion pattern in comparison to endogenously phosphorylated Ycf1

questions.question: What functional effect followed R-domain dephosphorylation in the ATPase assay?

options.A: A drastic reduction in ATPase activity
options.B: A twofold increase in ATPase activity
options.C: No change in ATPase activity, despite altered proteolysis
options.D: An increase in GSSG-stimulated ATPase but a loss of basal activity

questions.rationale: The authors report a drastic activity reduction after dephosphorylation, supporting the functional importance of the phosphorylated R-domain contacts.
questions.evidence_quote: ATPase assays show a drastic activity reduction in dephosphorylated Ycf1

questions.question: Which surface-area values quantify the R-domain interface in IFnarrow versus IFwide?

options.A: About 1530 Å² in IFnarrow and 1338 Å² in IFwide
options.B: About 1338 Å² in IFnarrow and 1530 Å² in IFwide
options.C: About 523 Å² in IFnarrow and 480 Å² in IFwide for the entire R-domain
options.D: About 1530 Å² in both states, with no interface burial

questions.rationale: The reported total buried surface area along the R-domain is larger in IFnarrow; NBD1-specific area is ~523 versus ~480 Å².
questions.evidence_quote: burying ~1530 Å 2 and ~1338 Å 2 of surface area along the entire R-domain in IFnarrow and IFwide, respectively

questions.question: Which residue-angle change accompanies the IFwide-to-IFnarrow transition and how do the authors interpret its role?

options.A: The G913–G918–G932 angle changes from 130° to 137.5°, with G918 and G932 acting as a hinge
options.B: The R716–R206 angle changes from 137.5° to 130°, breaking the phosphate scaffold
options.C: The G913–G918–G932 angle changes from 137.5° to 130°, closing the inactive NBD2 site
options.D: The S908–T911–S914 angle changes from 130° to 137.5°, driving dephosphorylation

questions.rationale: The glycine-capped helical R-domain segment moves as a hinge between the two conformations.
questions.evidence_quote: a change in angle between residues G913, G918 and G932 of the R-domain from 130º (IFwide) to 137.5º (IFnarrow)

questions.question: What ATP-site asymmetry characterizes IFnarrow?

options.A: The nonfunctional NBD1 site is occluded while the active NBD2 site remains open for ATP binding
options.B: The active NBD2 site is occluded while NBD1 becomes ATP competent
options.C: Both sites are open and occupied by ATP
options.D: Both ATP sites are occluded by the R-domain

questions.rationale: The transition brings ATP sites closer and rotates them to occlude NBD1's nonfunctional site while leaving NBD2 accessible.
questions.evidence_quote: rotate to occlude the non-functional ATP binding site in NBD1

questions.question: What limitation did the authors acknowledge about their structural interpretation of the inhibitory S251 site?

options.A: S251 was not observed phosphorylated in the structure; its inhibitory role is proposed from accessibility and potential phosphate repulsion
options.B: S251 could not be modeled because it lies inside the membrane-spanning cavity
options.C: S251 phosphorylation was detected only in the IFnarrow state and directly measured to block ATP
options.D: S251 had no sequence conservation and was not considered relevant to Ycf1 function

questions.rationale: The authors did not observe S251 phosphorylation, but its exposed position near R-domain phosphosites suggests a plausible electrostatic inhibitory mechanism.
questions.evidence_quote: Though we do not observe phosphorylation in our structure at this position, S251 is accessible to the surface and poised to disrupt R-domain interactions through electrostatic repulsion of phosphate groups in the R-domain
